reviews.title: Works well but there’s no point in it.
reviews.text:
On the plus side, the app is easy to use, smooth, and makes online ordering easy. In the downside, there’s no point to it. 

Unlike other fast food apps, there isn’t a point system when you order that you can save up for free food later. And even worse, they offer absolutely no deals of any kind for using the app. So again I ask, what’s the point in using this?

reviews.title: Signing up horror
reviews.text: I used to eat at five guys quite often, but I never used the app. There was a promotion of a buy one get one free burger so I figured it was time that I should download the app. I proceeded to fill out all the information that was requested. When it came time to pick a password, that’s where everything went south. Apparently the algorithm picks a password for you, which you cannot alter. Then when you hit proceed, it tells you that the characters did not meet the requirements. This is an extremely large glitch that you need to fix.  I guess I will not be using the app.  Pretty convenient that most of your deals have to deal with the app, which doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Missing Key Functionality
reviews.text: If the main purpose of this app is to allow for ordering to avoid the waiting time at the store, it’s missing a piece of functionality that makes it unusable. Not being able to add custom instructions to the fries (like ‘no salt’) means you have to do it in person making the app a missed opportunity. reviews.title: Update ALWAYS Required
reviews.text: Genuinely annoying to live in an age where you need an app AT ALL just to order a burger. This app requires an update EVERY TIME I go to order it. Developers, I work in IT too. Stop taking yourselves so seriously. The menu has 6 items on it. Also, the payment and checkout always breaks and bugs out. Not even sure if the payment processed this time. I got the text, but I also got an infinite loading screen for 60 full seconds and no confirmation. I guess all those app updates and they still couldnt knock down the most important thing...payment. Uninstalling, I need to diet anyway. STOP UPDATING YOUR SLOP APP.

reviews.title: Worst App UX Ever. They served me just bread and meat.
reviews.text:
This app is incredibly user-unfriendly. There is zero basic explanation of how the burger is configured. When ordering, the toppings were listed under 'Optional,' so naturally, I didn't select them, thinking it would come with the standard toppings. But guess what? I literally received just buns and patty. Who on earth eats a burger like that? It makes absolutely no sense to hide essential ingredients under a vague 'optional' section without any clear warning. Fix your terrible app interface.
But manager is kind.

reviews.title: Broken, buggy signup form
reviews.text:
I haven’t even gotten into this app yet and I already hate it.

The signup form is a mess. God forbid I want to autofill my email…you can’t do it and the app crashes every time you try.

Ok, let’s enter it manually and move on. I tried to use the phone’s generated strong password. Nope. It hides most of it behind some yellow gradient and doesn’t copy it to the “confirm” box. You can’t manually type it, because of the stupid yellow field masking. You can’t even delete the password, because that field is now completely frozen.

Let’s close the app and try this for 4th time.

Now I’ve finally done all that the slow, manual way and I’m ready to enter my birthday. The dates are wrong. I select June 17. The form shows 06/16. I have to select June 18 for it to show 06/17.

It took me nearly 10-15 minutes just to create an account, which is a pretty bad omen for how the rest of this terrible app is going to work…

Update: I deleted this terrible app and went back to Uber Eats. Even with uber charging $2 more for the burger, it somehow came out to the same price. There are no rewards or loyalty benefits from five guys so what’s the point of this broken app?!

reviews.title: Authentication flows are terrible
reviews.text:
Trying to create an account is awful. The password field is WAY too strict for a fast food app. When you leave the app to generate a password in a password manager, fields in the form reset. If you want to modify the password you typed (so you can satisfy the strict requirements) typing another character can delete the whole password you entered. And it doesn’t consider all special characters to be special characters. It feels like a poorly-executed account creation for a bank website with how much effort you have to put in.

Also, I placed a pickup order and the app never alerted me when the order was done. But someone else I was with did get an alert and his order wasn’t complete yet. Five Guys needs to figure out how to fix the notification system and processes.

It took me almost a half and hour to set up an account and order my food because of the above. And then the food was cold because there was no announcement it was ready and no notification. Overall a bad experience.

reviews.title: App is bugged and no rewards program
reviews.text: Great food but this is the beginning of the end for five guys, they’re so far behind their competitors in terms of technology and customer loyalty. Also, if you’re going to run a promotion you should be ready for it, it took me 30 minutes to order the food because the app is so bugged and then it took about 2 hours to actually have my food be delivered. Say goodbye while you still can because this company is going under after yesterday’s BOGO chaos

reviews.title: Apple Pay
reviews.text: Love the food but the point of this review is for the app. The app doesn’t function well. Multiple times I have went in and tried to use apple pay for payment and it just completely doesn’t work. The proceed to checkout button doesn’t work. I can’t understand rating a food app anything above 3 stars when the necessary functions to order don’t work. The whole point of the app is convenience and if apple pay isn’t supported then it shouldn’t be a listed option.

reviews.title: Requiring me to update 10 days after release without an explanation means NO SALE
reviews.text: I finished my grocery shopping and was going to order dinner in the app for the fam, but the app said "NO WAY" because I didn't update to the release 10 days ago.  Luckily there were alot of good choices in the same plaza so I was able to get food quickly and efficiently elsewhere (burgers no less, for cheaper!) I'm probably not going to chance this again so will have to not put Five Guys as a first line choice.

reviews.title: Why even have a button
reviews.text:
Guys, why would you have a button that says “tap when here” that doesn’t do anything. We tap it, walk in and they say, “you have to talk to someone before we start your order”. Then we wait an hour after we ordered our food to even get our order. So, why have the button? Why use the app?

If you are using the app just know it doesn’t do much but let you see a menu and say what you want. You’ll still need to go wait in line at the store regardless.
